facts.fact: 她用浴室柜里翻出的 Elnett 发胶做了新发型——「那本来不是我的东西」。
facts.anchor: gently freeing them from the stiffness of the Elnett hairspray I found in the bathroom cabinet.

facts.fact: 14 岁第一次挑染的回忆：Donna 在自家厨房用果冻帽折腾了她一个多小时。
facts.anchor: Then, she tortured me for over an hour, stabbing at my scalp with a tiny sword, scooping strands of hair free from the cap

facts.fact: 她的过去大多模糊——记得的多半是「别人画的画」，她只是照单全收。
facts.anchor: Most things I can claim to remember have likely been a picture painted by someone else’s brush and I’ve just gone along with it.

facts.fact: 惊喜约会在周四撞车：她把星期几都搞错了，他累到爆。
facts.anchor: ‘Are you having a laugh? It’s Thursday – not Friday – and I’m fucking shattered.

facts.fact: 她不吃早餐被发现，他扬言做「傻瓜版饮食计划」——像在对小孩说话。
facts.anchor: he said he’d start making me dummy-proof meal plans.

facts.fact: 洋葱爆点：同一份咖喱他上周吃得一毫不剩——今天却说「我不吃洋葱」。
facts.anchor: He devoured this exact meal last week, not one slither left behind.

facts.fact: 他发作：你不听、你是想害我吗——「没咒念了就改用这种低级手段？」
facts.anchor: I’m allergic, remember? I’ve told you this, but you don’t listen. You never listen when you’re supposed to.

facts.fact: 他数恩情：把你从黑暗洞穴里捞出来、拼命工作、什么都不要——手指戳着她的锁骨逼她「说出一件事」。
facts.anchor: I took you out of that dark cave. I go out and work long fucking days. You don’t need to worry about a thing, and I don’t ask you for anything, do I?
